---
title: "Exploring Storms"
author: "Emma"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: storms-plot

storms |>
  filter(status %in% c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane")) |> # Keep only the three main storm types
  mutate(status = factor(status, levels = c("tropical depression", "tropical storm", "hurricane"))) |> # Order from weakest to strongest
  distinct(year, name, status) |> # Keep one row per unique storm and status in each year
  count(year, status) |> # Count the number of storms of each type per year
  complete(year, status, fill = list(n = 0)) |> # Fill missing year/status pairs with 0 for smooth stacking
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, fill = status)) +
  geom_area() + # Draw a stacked area chart
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "tropical depression" = "lightblue",
      "tropical storm" = "orange",
      "hurricane" = "darkred"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Named Storms per Year by Type",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Storms",
    fill = "Storm Type"
  )
```

```{r}
#| cache: true

storms_recent <- storms |> # Save the filtered and selected tibble to storms_recent
  filter(year >= 2000) |> # Keep observations from the year 2000 and later
  select(year, name, status, wind, pressure) # Keep only these five columns in order
```

```{r}
#| label: pressure-wind-plot

storms_recent |>
  ggplot(aes(x = pressure, y = wind, color = status)) + # Map pressure, wind, and status color
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) + # Use semi-transparent points to show overlapping observations
  labs(
    title = "Lower Air Pressure Corresponds to Higher Storm Wind Speeds",
    subtitle = "Atlantic storm observations from 2000 onward by storm classification",
    x = "Air Pressure (millibars)",
    y = "Wind Speed (knots)",
    color = "Storm Status"
  )
```
